response.justification: The candidate is a versatile senior engineer with 15+ years of experience, strong software craftsmanship, and some genuine high-scale systems work (low-latency services handling millions of requests per second at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic). However, the resume shows no evidence of the role's core domain: experimentation platforms, A/B testing, feature flagging, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or statistical analysis. There is also little demonstrated principal-level scope such as multi-workstream leadership, cross-team platform ownership, or organization-wide architectural influence, making the fit weak for an IC6 growth/experimentation position despite solid engineering fundamentals.
strengths: Broad, hands-on full-stack experience across many languages (TypeScript, Java, C/C++, C#, DLang) exceeding the 8+ year requirement
Real high-scale distributed systems experience with low-latency microservices handling millions of requests per second
Recent AI-agent tooling work (MCP code generators, agentic workflows) aligns with the AI-first emphasis
concerns: No experimentation, A/B testing, feature-flagging, or rollout-risk management experience anywhere in the resume
No evidence of telemetry/metrics infrastructure or statistical/experimental analysis work
Career trajectory is senior-level generalist IC; lacks demonstrated principal-scope leadership across teams and multi-workstream initiatives

key_factors.factor: Strong engineering fundamentals and scale experience
